description: P3 coupling. plugin/skills/design-review/SKILL.md owns the design review's round rules. The source pin spans the cap clause's condition and obligation: a review that did not converge in 3 rounds is told to the maintainer unprompted, and the initiative is split before its docs merge. Further pins in the same file each carry one load-bearing rule: the open-zero gate (stop=open-findings refuses the pass until the round's findings land), the confirming-round scope (only the diff and the fixes to the previous round's findings), the tool-pass condition (one hivemind:adaptation-cycle pass only when the design touches a trust boundary, credentials or the merge path) and its skip (no tool configured or a tool that cannot run skips the pass and the record says so), the model fallback (an unreachable model yields no round and the pass re-runs on cerebrate's own model), the disposition rule (critical and high findings are only fixed or rejected), the diminishing-returns check's three options, the later-round disposition (a finding that only a later round can close is rejected with that reason; the pin starts at the end of the sentence that disposes every finding, so moving the rule away from that sentence turns the suite red), the review-fix override (with review_fix yes, one confirming round runs whatever stop=passed, stop=cap-reached or next=<n> says, stated before the lines it overrides), the tool-pass Angle (its findings take Angle review), the clean-round rule (a round is clean only when every completed pass raises no new finding and finds no earlier finding unfixed) and the repeat rule (a finding of any pass contesting a recorded decision is a repeat per the doctrine's Recorded Decisions and Repeat Findings, not new). The repeat rule names the doctrine's term with no qualifier, so the doctrine's definition is its only scope; a qualifier inserted inside the pinned sentence turns the suite red, one added in another sentence does not. Deleting any pinned clause turns the suite red. The record-format consumer pins its Disposition set with the critical and high rule, its pass rule (verdict pass, every open count 0, clean_round true, rounds 2 to 3, which requires a confirming round after round 1), its Note rule (a rejected repeat's reason cites the recorded decision it repeats) and the two clauses that keep a stamp path from naming a directory: each stamp path names one document, and the document existence test reads a tree as missing. The adaptation-cycle consumer pins its design-review caller line: base is the previous round's reviewed commit, round 1 the merge-base with trunk, with a fixed focus. The idea-to-ready consumer pins the guide's round comment: its clean flag is yes for a clean round. Residuals: a pin proves only that these word sequences exist in the named files, not that the skill obeys them; every pin is whole-file, so any other rule that moves out of its step or section stays green; a rewrite-around or a meaning inversion that keeps the pinned bytes, or a new caller that omits the rules, is invisible; no pin proves the skill classifies a finding as a repeat, or as one only a later round can close, correctly, or that the doctrine's definition of a recorded decision stays what the skill needs. No pass is told the later-round rule: a pass can raise such a finding, the disposition step rejects it so it is never open, and it still counts as a new finding of its round.

Disposition: exactly one of `fixed`, `rejected`, `deferred`, `recorded` or `open`. A critical or high finding is only `fixed` or `rejected`.
